text:
Riley - People Ops: quick Q from Nate: manager requested an out-of-cycle promotion + base increase effective 2026-08-01 but start date is 2026-08-18. what approvals and docs do we need to accept an earlier effective date? cc @Priya @Sofia

Nate - Eng Manager: they want SWE II -> SWE III and bump to align with new band. candidate signed offer showing start 8/18. manager prefers 8/1 effective for org chart and billing reasons.

Sofia - Comp: salary retro is allowed if we have a signed amendment stating the effective date and reason. we will daily-pro-rate retro pay. equity/grant dates should not be backdated without comp+legal sign-off.

Priya - Payroll: operational requirements: signed amendment, Comp-approved backpay calc, payroll reason code, and tax country check. payroll cutoff for Aug manual adjustments: 2026-08-25 23:59 PST. example command we use: manual_adjust --eid 010010 --period 2026-08 --retro_start 2026-08-01 --amount <amt> --note "OC promo retro"

Omar - Legal: for most jurisdictions we need the employee to be on payroll to withhold taxes for retro periods. If they're not, we may classify the amount as a sign-on payment. Please include country of hire in the packet. Also add a tax liability acknowledgement in the amendment.

Nate - Eng Manager: country = Germany. Is that a blocker?

Omar - Legal: Germany typically requires payroll presence for retro pay; treating as sign-on tied to hire date is often safer. I'll confirm with local counsel if you upload contract + amendment.

Riley - People Ops: proposed checklist: 1) Nate uploads signed amendment (explicit effective date + tax clause). 2) Sofia posts backpay calc (daily pro-rate). 3) Priya confirms payroll run window and tax memo. 4) Omar confirms Germany-specific ruling. 5) People Ops authorizes payroll run.
